```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
```


```{r}
comedicationdata <- read_csv("comedication_full_data.csv")
comedicationdata1 <- comedicationdata %>% 
  dplyr::rename( "patient_group" = "treatment",
                 "parameter_co" = "labreads",
                 "kathegorie_co" = "kathegorie",
                 "drug_group_co" = "drug_group")

comedicationdata1
```



```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Schritt 1: Entferne Duplikate, falls ein Patient ein Medikament mehrfach gelistet hat
unique_data <- comedicationdata1 %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, Medication)

# Schritt 2: Zähle, wie viele verschiedene Medikamente jeder Patient hatte
med_count_per_patient <- unique_data %>%
  group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>%
  summarise(comedication_count = n())

# Schritt 3: Zähle, wie viele Patienten jeweils eine bestimmte Anzahl an Medikamenten hatten
patients_per_medcount <- med_count_per_patient %>%
  group_by(comedication_count) %>%
  summarise(patient_count = n()) %>%
  arrange(comedication_count)

# Ergebnis anzeigen
print(patients_per_medcount)
```






```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Sicherstellen, dass medication_count numerisch sortierbar ist
patients_per_medcount <- patients_per_medcount %>%
  arrange(comedication_count)

count_of_patients_per_comedication_intake <- ggplot(patients_per_medcount, aes(x = comedication_count, y = patient_count)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("N = ", patient_count)),
    vjust = -0.3,  # Positionierung leicht oberhalb des Balkens
    size = 3       # Optional: kleinere Schriftgröße
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Count of Patients per Comedication Intake", 
    x = "Comedication Count", 
    y = "Patient Count"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = patients_per_medcount$comedication_count  # Alle Werte anzeigen
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

dir.create("plots_comedications patient count", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_comedications patient count/count_of_patients_per_comedication_intake.svg", height = 8, width = 12)
print(count_of_patients_per_comedication_intake)
dev.off()
```




```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Step 1: Summary of how many patients have how many medications

patient_comed <- comedicationdata1 %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, Medication) %>% 
  group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>% 
  summarise(comedication = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(comedication) %>% 
  summarise(patient_num_per_med = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Get distinct patient-medication pairs
distinct_data <- comedicationdata1 %>%
  distinct(bfarm_nummer, Medication)

# Step 3: Create a list based on the actual `comedication` values from patient_comed

medication_groups <- map(patient_comed$comedication, function(n) {
  distinct_data %>%
    group_by(bfarm_nummer) %>%
    filter(n() == !!n) %>%
    arrange(bfarm_nummer)
})

# Step 4: Name the list elements based on the number of meds

names(medication_groups) <- paste0("patients_with_", patient_comed$comedication, "_meds")

# Example: show patients with 2 medications
medication_groups$patients_with_2_meds

```

### venn diagramm ###


```{r}
medication_sets <- map(medication_groups, ~ unique(.x$Medication))

```

```{r}
group_names <- names(medication_sets)

pairwise_combinations <- combn(group_names, 2, simplify = FALSE)

```

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)


dir.create("venn plots_medication count", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Loop over all combinations
for (pair in pairwise_combinations) {
  group1 <- pair[1]
  group2 <- pair[2]

  meds1 <- medication_sets[[group1]]
  meds2 <- medication_sets[[group2]]

  venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
    x = list(
      Group1 = meds1,
      Group2 = meds2
    ),
    filename = paste0("venn plots_medication count/", group1, "_vs_", group2, ".png"),
    output = TRUE,
    category.names = c(group1, group2),
    fill = c("blue", "yellow"),
    alpha = 0.5,
    cex = 1.5,                # Size of intersection counts
    fontface = "bold",

    cat.cex = 1.5,            # Size of category labels
    cat.fontface = "bold",
    cat.pos = c(-15, 15),     # Shift labels vertically
    cat.dist = c(0.05, 0.05), # Move labels slightly outward
    cat.just = list(c(0.5, 1), c(0.5, 1)), # Centered top alignment
    margin = 0.1
  )
}

```

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)

dir.create("venn plots_medication count", showWarnings = FALSE)

for (pair in pairwise_combinations) {
  group1 <- pair[1]
  group2 <- pair[2]

  # Entferne NA-Werte aus den Mengen
  meds1 <- medication_sets[[group1]]
  meds2 <- medication_sets[[group2]]

  meds1 <- meds1[!is.na(meds1)]
  meds2 <- meds2[!is.na(meds2)]

  venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
    x = list(
      Group1 = meds1,
      Group2 = meds2
    ),
    filename = paste0("venn plots_medication count/", group1, "_vs_", group2, ".png"),
    output = TRUE,
    category.names = c(group1, group2),
    fill = c("blue", "yellow"),
    alpha = 0.5,
    cex = 1.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    cat.cex = 1.5,
    cat.fontface = "bold",
    cat.pos = c(-15, 15),
    cat.dist = c(0.05, 0.05),
    cat.just = list(c(0.5, 1), c(0.5, 1)),
    margin = 0.1
  )
}

```
